main_text.p: 16. & multis diebus ibidem docuit, hospitio vsus Lydiæ purpurissæ, mox vterque ibi cæsus & in carcerem coniectus est propter spiritum Pytho-nis à puella eiectum, sed mox mirabili Dei con-silio gloriosè iterum emittitur. Hos igitur recte à se antea institutos, nunc absens confirmat in suscepta doctrina, hortaturque vt constanter in fide persistentes, professionem hanc vitæ inno-centia ornent.

Occasio scribendi oblata est ex domesticis dissidiis, quæ gliscebant, vt est videre cap.1.v.18. & cap. 2. v. 3. & 4. vbi hortatur ne quid per contentionem & æmulationem agant. Præterea imminebant ipsis, vt & aliis Ecclesiis pericula & persecutiones, in quibus ignominia crucis, & præsens Apostoli captiuitas multos percellebat, quæ omnia hac epistola diluit ipsosque contra hæc pericula & offendicula confirmat. Insuper sollicitabantur à falsis doctoribus, vt circumcisionem & alia onera legis admitterent, vt est videre capite tertio: ne igitur his eueniret quod Galatis acciderat, præmonet ne hos doctores admittant, imo tanquam canes & hostes crucis Christi diligenter caueant. Denique in ipsum Apostolum multa contulerant beneficia, pro quibus voluit illis agere gratias, vt est cap. 4.

Propositio & Argumentum Epistolæ ex his quæ dicta sunt, facile colligitur. Principalis pro-positio est, in hac ipsa doctrina Christianæ Religionis, quam acceperunt à Paulo, constanter Philippensibus perdurandum est, solum vitæ innocentia eandem strenuè ornent, vsque ad aduentum Domini Christi. Hoc totum Apostolus

page.notes: The first line begins mid-paragraph with verse number "16.", so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The catchword "lus" at the lower right is uncertain: it may be the start of a word continued on the next page, so it is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Hyphenated line breaks are kept as printed ("pro-positio", "Pytho-nis", "con-silio", "inno-centia"). The "cap.1.v.18." reference is read as "1" with some doubt. The strip at the right edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.
